explanation: The theorem is exactness of a reduced Mayer–Vietoris sequence in degree 0 for singular homology. It is stated with the library's own definitions (twoOpenReducedMayerVietoris*, reducedSingularHomology). I grepped Mathlib for MayerVietoris and reducedSingularHomology. The only hits were the sheaf and sheaf-cohomology Mayer–Vietoris files (Topology/Sheaves/MayerVietoris, CategoryTheory/Sites/SheafCohomology/MayerVietoris, CategoryTheory/Sites/MayerVietorisSquare). None of them concerns singular homology, so none states this result.
